contexts.text: To the south are those in the light of truth.
(The candlestick)... on the side of the habitation towards the south ()... = in Heaven where the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine Human is in the greatest light.
The south in Heaven is where the Lord appears as a Moon.
Hence the court, relatively to the habitation, was made to the south.
Expand her wings towards the south () = to lead one's self into the light of intelligence.
When ye see the south wind blowing () = preaching concerning His advent.
